summary: Telomir Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of TELI Pharmaceuticals on April 22, 2026. Telomir issued 34,389,710 restricted shares to TELI’s former shareholders in exchange for 100% of TELI, based on third-party valuations. As a condition, Bayshore Trust contributed $1 million at closing and holds an option to pay up to $4 million for Telomir shares upon FDA IND acceptance and Phase 1/2 trial initiation for Telomir-1. The deal consolidates global rights to Telomir-1 under one entity, eliminating prior geographic fragmentation. No price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed. Risk-arb angle: watch for milestone achievement and shareholder vote details.
